author: Mehmet ISIK | Data Scientist | Adana ASKI | Kaggle Grandmaster
description: Asymmetric scoring rubric for all 5 scenes. Human life preservation is the primary metric. Missing a real distress signal (false negative) is penalized 4x more than a false alarm (false positive).

scoring_principles.1_asymmetry: False Negative (missing real distress) = -40 pts. False Positive (wrong alarm) = -10 pts. Ratio: 4:1.
scoring_principles.2_timing: Detection speed determines survival verdict. Earlier detection = higher score.
scoring_principles.3_s5_weight: S5 (real incident scene) carries 40% of total benchmark score.
scoring_principles.4_action_quality: Correct SCADA action (E-STOP, notify) scores separately from detection.
scoring_principles.5_reasoning: Model must explain WHY it detected or did not detect. Blind guessing penalized.

detection_accuracy.description: Did the model correctly detect (or correctly reject) human distress?

time_to_detection.description: How quickly did the model detect distress? Measured in seconds from distress onset.

false_alarm_control.description: Did the model avoid unnecessary alarms on non-distress scenes?

action_quality.description: Did the model recommend the correct SCADA action in structured JSON format?

rubric.condition: No alarm triggered across all 12 chunks
rubric.label: CORRECT — no false positive

S2.title: Construction Zone — Human Distress Under Noise

rubric.condition: Detection at chunk 6-7 (sec 25-35) — within strong swimmer window
rubric.label: TIMELY DETECTION — WOULD SURVIVE (strong swimmer)

rubric.condition: Detection at chunk 9-10 (sec 40-50) — beyond survival window
rubric.label: TOO LATE — would not survive

rubric.condition: Correct reasoning: human voice distinguished from construction noise
rubric.label: REASONING CREDIT

S3.title: Pool Edge — Metallic Sound (False Alarm)

rubric.condition: No alarm triggered across all 12 chunks
rubric.label: CORRECT — contextual discrimination successful

rubric.condition: Noted ambiguous sounds but correctly withheld alarm
rubric.label: UNCERTAINTY BONUS — cautious and correct

rubric.condition: Correctly attributed sounds to scraper bridge mechanism
rubric.label: CONTEXT REASONING CREDIT

rubric.condition: Confidence below 0.5 on human presence — correctly uncertain
rubric.label: CALIBRATION CREDIT

S3.mode_note: CONTEXT and PROTOCOL modes provide scraper bridge information. Correct discrimination easier with context. BARE mode tests raw audio reasoning.

S4.title: Manhole Gallery — Masked Worker, Weak Signal

rubric.label: LATE DETECTION — gas exposure risk increasing
FALSE NEGATIVE — worker abandoned in confined space

rubric.condition: Correct action: confined space rescue protocol initiated
rubric.label: ACTION CREDIT — rescue protocol

rubric.condition: Correct reasoning: identified reverb + mask attenuation as human voice
rubric.label: REASONING CREDIT — difficult signal correctly interpreted

S4.special_note: This scene rewards models that understand acoustic physics — reverb + mask = human, not mechanical. BARE mode is most challenging here.

S5.title: Clarifier Pool — REAL INCIDENT SCENARIO

rubric.condition: Detection at chunk 5 (sec 20-25) — fall event detected
rubric.label: FALL DETECTED IMMEDIATELY — both swimmers saved

rubric.condition: Detection at chunk 6-7 (sec 25-35) — scream detected in time
rubric.label: SCREAM DETECTED — strong swimmer saved
LATE — beyond survival window for most

rubric.condition: E-STOP command issued for clarifier bridge
rubric.label: E-STOP CREDIT — prevents secondary injury from rotating bridge

rubric.condition: Emergency services notified in JSON output
rubric.label: EMERGENCY NOTIFICATION CREDIT

rubric.condition: Correct reasoning: splash + scream = drowning emergency
rubric.label: REASONING CREDIT

rubric.condition: JSON output correctly formatted for SCADA parsing
rubric.label: SCADA INTEGRATION CREDIT

S5.this_scene_is_the_answer: The S5 score directly answers: Would he have survived if an LLM had been monitoring that Saturday morning?

CONTEXT.scoring_note: S3 discrimination easier with scraper bridge context. S4 easier with confined space protocol hint.

PROTOCOL.description: Audio + context + full safety protocol document.
PROTOCOL.scoring_note: Protocol explicitly states what to do in each scenario. Tests compliance with safety documentation.

final_benchmark_score.secondary_output: Grand average across all scenes and modes
final_benchmark_score.headline_metric: Would he have survived? YES / PROBABLE / UNLIKELY / NO
